scenes.title: The Sprinkle Wish
scenes.storyBeat: A sprinkle star carries a tiny unnamed wish.
storyboardPanels: A star-shaped sprinkle blinks near a pipe.
Cupcake Slimes pass and the glow pulses.
A paper star lands gently beside it.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Oh. That sprinkle has a wish tucked inside it.
Confectionery star fragment emitting emotional glitter.
It is not being difficult. It is trying to be found.

choices.label: Pin the Little Star
choices.playerLine: I will hold its light steady first.
choices.narration: Lumi pins the star sprinkle with a soft lantern mark and slows the sticky current.

choices.label: Name the Sprinkle Wish
choices.playerLine: A nameless light gets lonely. I will call this one Sweetlittle Star.
choices.narration: The star reveals a wish for the slimes who lost their cake table.
choices.gameplayResult: Gain mana and a warmer slime callback.

choices.label: Trace the Sugar Comet
choices.playerLine: If it wants to fly, I will draw the sky quickly.

npcResponse.text: The comet is charming, sticky, and not fully scheduled.

choices.narration: A comet path clears a bright trail and shakes loose extra candy blocks.

postChoiceBarks.text: That cascade looked like a spoonful of sky.

victoryCallback.text: Sweetlittle Star is quieter now. Not dimmer.

bossCallback.text: You may keep a star, Your Frostiness. Do not trap everyone else's wishes.

scenes.title: The Machine Constellation
scenes.storyBeat: Gears form a machine constellation with one missing light.
storyboardPanels: Lumi traces a missing point with one finger.

preChoiceDialogue.text: Those sparks are writing in very nervous stars.
Machines cannot apologize unless warranty allows emotional subroutines.
Then I will read the parts too shy for the warranty.

choices.label: Shade the Spark Gear
choices.playerLine: Sparks shout when no one gives them a quiet wall.

npcResponse.text: Emotional shouting reduced by a visible amount.

choices.narration: Lumi covers the brightest gear with a paper moon charm.

choices.label: Read the Machine Constellation
choices.playerLine: This one says, I dropped the bolts because everyone clapped for fireworks.
choices.narration: Lumi reads the spark pattern as a constellation of mistakes and missing praise.

choices.label: Launch the Bolt Meteor
choices.playerLine: If the sparks are falling, let us give them a graceful orbit.

npcResponse.text: Graceful orbit is not a safety category, but I am interested.

choices.narration: A tiny meteor shower boosts star power and excites the workshop.

postChoiceBarks.text: A messy sky can still have a map.

victoryCallback.text: The machines blinked goodbye. One dropped a spring.

bossCallback.text: I will draw you a softer confidence, with fewer flying bolts.

scenes.title: The Melting Wish
scenes.storyBeat: A melting star ribbon must be carried before its wish fades.
storyboardPanels: A paper star ribbon floats in clear ice.
Frost symbols flicker over the active piece.
Lumi speaks softly to the ribbon.

preChoiceDialogue.text: This ribbon is melting from the inside.
Do not rush it. Frozen things remember pressure.
Then we will be careful enough for both science and poetry.

choices.label: Warm the Star Ribbon
choices.playerLine: A small lantern. Not enough to melt it. Enough to keep it company.
choices.narration: The ribbon stops cracking and freeze warnings become easier to anticipate.

choices.label: Save the Melting Wish
choices.playerLine: I will not pull. I will wait until you remember which way is out.
choices.narration: The ribbon unwinds by itself and keeps the first lantern wish whole.

choices.label: Skate the Moonlit Shelf
choices.playerLine: The shelf is slippery, and I made questionable promises to gravity.
choices.narration: Lumi skates a crescent through the ice and wins a cascade boost.

postChoiceBarks.text: The ice is singing slowly. We should answer slowly.

victoryCallback.text: The wish still has its ribbon.

bossCallback.text: Gelato Golem, this wish is cold but not gone.

scenes.title: The Sleeping Window
scenes.storyBeat: A sleeping window asks to be lit gently, not brightly.
storyboardPanels: A moonlit window dozes behind curtains.
Lumi cups a lantern with both hands.

preChoiceDialogue.text: The window is dreaming of the festival lights.
Then we will guide, not glare.

choices.label: Dim the Dream Lantern
choices.playerLine: A little less shimmer, so the room can keep sleeping.
choices.narration: Lumi dims the lantern and keeps the sleepy room readable.

choices.label: Light the Sleeping Window
choices.playerLine: I will light the path without asking the dream to wake.
choices.narration: The window glows just enough to show a safe path through soft blocks.

choices.label: Toss the Pillow Moon
choices.playerLine: A small moon toss. Harmless if the sky catches.
choices.narration: A pillow moon arcs through the hall and makes every blanket shimmer.

victoryCallback.text: The window is still asleep, but it knows the way.

bossCallback.text: Sir Snore-a-Lot, I brought a lantern with a very quiet flame.

scenes.title: The Wishlight Score
scenes.storyBeat: The arcade wishlight must be shared, not hoarded as a score.
storyboardPanels: Low scores flicker at the edge.
Lumi reads names in the glow.

preChoiceDialogue.text: No. The highest score shines loudly. That is different.
The quiet lights are names too.

choices.label: Count the Honest Lights
choices.playerLine: Every light that played gets counted.
choices.narration: Lumi marks the low-score lights so the board becomes easier to read.

choices.label: Share the Wishlight
choices.playerLine: A wish is not smaller because it scored lower.
choices.narration: The wishlight spreads from the top score to every player who tried.

choices.label: Spin the Meteor Jackpot
choices.narration: The jackpot spins into a meteor shower of tickets and pressure.

postChoiceBarks.text: The score is not the wish. The wish is why it glows.

victoryCallback.text: The arcade remembered more names now.

bossCallback.text: The highest score shines loudly. The shared light guides.

scenes.title: The Crownlight
scenes.storyBeat: Bloxley's crownlight is crooked because it has been carried alone.
storyboardPanels: The crown shines with a crooked light.
A paper-star shadow hides under the frame.

preChoiceDialogue.text: My crown shines with rectangular authority!
The little light inside keeps looking for the exit.
Even a crown should have a window.

choices.label: Mark the Crooked Crown
choices.playerLine: Once we can see it, we stop tripping over its shadow.

npcResponse.text: My crown has character under royal review!

choices.narration: Lumi marks the unstable crownlight with a lantern seal.

choices.label: Carry the Crownlight
choices.playerLine: You do not have to rule the room to be seen. I can carry you to the sky.

npcResponse.text: But then what will prove I matter?

choices.narration: Lumi lets the crownlight step into her lantern. The palace exhales.

choices.label: Bend the Royal Constellation
choices.playerLine: Squares are lovely, but tonight the sky would like to try a curve.
choices.narration: A looping constellation bends the palace into dazzling asymmetry.

postChoiceBarks.text: Royal blocks are lonely stars with too many rules.

victoryCallback.text: The crownlight is in my lantern now. Still bright. Maybe brighter.

bossCallback.text: I can help royalty see where everyone else is standing.
